col.name: PATIENT_ID
description: Unique patient identifier. Required in the patient file, and required in the sample file to map each sample to its patient. Allowed characters: numbers, letters, points, underscores and hyphens.

col.name: OS_STATUS
description: Overall patient survival status. Paired with OS_MONTHS to draw the overall survival plot. Value must be prefixed with 0: (no event) or 1: (event occurred). In the patient view 0:LIVING renders a green label and 1:DECEASED a red label. cBioPortal study-view priority: 400 for the overall survival plot.

col.name: OS_MONTHS
description: Overall survival in months since initial diagnosis. Paired with OS_STATUS to draw the overall survival plot. cBioPortal study-view priority: 400 for the overall survival plot.

col.name: DFS_STATUS
description: Disease free status since initial treatment. Paired with DFS_MONTHS to draw the disease-free survival plot. Value must be prefixed with 0: (no event) or 1: (event occurred). In the patient view 0:DiseaseFree renders a green label and 1:Recurred/Progressed a red label. cBioPortal study-view priority: 300 for the disease-free survival plot.

col.name: DFS_MONTHS
description: Disease free survival in months since initial treatment. Paired with DFS_STATUS to draw the disease-free survival plot. cBioPortal study-view priority: 300 for the disease-free survival plot.

col.name: PFS_STATUS
description: Progression free status. Documented as an example of the generic survival-pair convention: any <PREFIX>_STATUS column paired with a <PREFIX>_MONTHS column generates a survival plot. Value must be prefixed with 0: (no event) or 1: (event occurred).

col.name: PFS_MONTHS
description: Progression free survival in months. Paired with PFS_STATUS to draw the progression-free survival plot.

col.name: PATIENT_DISPLAY_NAME
description: Patient display name shown in the patient view header.

col.name: GENDER
description: Gender of the patient, shown in the patient view header. Interchangeable with SEX. cBioPortal study-view priority: 9.

col.name: SEX
description: Sex of the patient, shown in the patient view header. Interchangeable with GENDER. cBioPortal study-view priority: 9.

col.name: AGE
description: Age at which the condition or disease was first diagnosed, in years. Shown in the patient view header. cBioPortal study-view priority: 8.

col.name: TUMOR_SITE
description: Tumor site of the patient. Overridden per sample by METASTATIC_SITE or PRIMARY_SITE.

col.name: SAMPLE_ID
description: Unique sample identifier. Allowed characters: numbers, letters, points, underscores and hyphens.

col.name: SAMPLE_DISPLAY_NAME
description: Sample display name shown in the patient view header in addition to the sample ID.

col.name: SAMPLE_CLASS
description: Sample class, shown with the sample in the patient view header.

col.name: METASTATIC_SITE
description: Site of a metastatic sample. Overrides the patient-level TUMOR_SITE.

col.name: PRIMARY_SITE
description: Site of a primary sample. Overrides the patient-level TUMOR_SITE.

col.name: SAMPLE_TYPE
description: Sample type. Affects the sample icon colour in the Timeline view: recurrence/recurred/progression/progressed = orange, metastatic/metastasis = red, primary or anything else = black.

col.name: TUMOR_TISSUE_SITE
description: Tumor tissue site. Affects the sample icon colour in the Timeline view: recurrence/recurred/progression/progressed = orange, metastatic/metastasis = red, primary or anything else = black.

col.name: TUMOR_TYPE
description: Tumor type. Affects the sample icon colour in the Timeline view: recurrence/recurred/progression/progressed = orange, metastatic/metastasis = red, primary or anything else = black.

col.name: CANCER_TYPE
description: Cancer type of the sample. Overrides the study-wide cancer type and is required for the pan-cancer summary statistics tab. cBioPortal study-view priority: 3000.

col.name: CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED
description: Cancer type detailed, a sub-type of the specified CANCER_TYPE. Required for the pan-cancer summary statistics tab. cBioPortal study-view priority: 2000.

col.name: KNOWN_MOLECULAR_CLASSIFIER
description: Known molecular classifier of the sample.

col.name: GLEASON_SCORE
description: Radical prostatectomy Gleason score for prostate cancer.

col.name: HISTOLOGY
description: Histological classification.

col.name: TUMOR_STAGE_2009
description: Tumor stage under the 2009 staging system.

col.name: TUMOR_GRADE
description: Tumor grade.

col.name: ETS_RAF_SPINK1_STATUS
description: ETS/RAF/SPINK1 molecular status.

col.name: TMPRSS2_ERG_FUSION_STATUS
description: TMPRSS2-ERG fusion status.

col.name: ERG_FUSION_ACGH
description: ERG fusion status determined by aCGH.

col.name: SERUM_PSA
description: Serum prostate-specific antigen level.

col.name: DRIVER_MUTATIONS
description: Driver mutation annotations.
